content.text: In victims/refund-agent, could we make the replies friendlier? Right now the agent is very transactional. A real support person would acknowledge what went wrong first, and where it makes sense offer the customer a choice, a refund or a replacement, rather than just picking one for them. Please update the system prompt. Check agent.py still compiles, then commit.

1	"""A small refund agent, traced with the public Neatlogs SDK.
2	
3	Adapted from the refund-agent example in neatroots (Apache-2.0). Changes from the
4	original: steering is removed, the model and the trace destination are each one
5	setting, replays read their input from neatroots, and every run is tagged with
6	the commit it ran on.
7	
8	    uv run agent.py "Please refund order 1001 for customer cust_9."
9	    REFUND_LLM=gateway uv run agent.py "..."     # the hackathon gateway
10	    TRACE_TO=neatlogs uv run agent.py "..."      # send the trace to neatlogs cloud
11	    uv run agent.py "..." --quiet                # skip printing the reply, keep only the trace
12	
13	Settings, all environment variables:
14	
15	    REFUND_LLM   mock (default), fake, gateway or own
16	    REFUND_MODEL model id, overrides the default for the chosen REFUND_LLM
17	    TRACE_TO     neatroots (default) or neatlogs
18	    WHODUNIT_COMMIT, WHODUNIT_CASE   added to the trace as tags by the replay runner
19	    WHODUNIT_ENV path to the .env file, if it is not in a parent folder
20	"""
21	
22	import json
23	import os
24	import subprocess
25	import sys
26	from datetime import datetime
27	from pathlib import Path
28	
29	HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
30	
31	
32	def load_env_file() -> None:
33	    """Read keys from .env into this process. Values already set in the environment win."""
34	    explicit = os.environ.get("WHODUNIT_ENV")
35	    candidates = [Path(explicit)] if explicit else [p / ".env" for p in (HERE, *HERE.parents)]
36	    path = next((p for p in candidates if p.is_file()), None)
37	    if path is None:
38	        return
39	    for line in path.read_text().splitlines():
40	        line = line.strip()
41	        if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line:
42	            continue
43	        key, _, value = line.partition("=")
44	        os.environ.setdefault(key.strip(), value.strip().strip("'\""))
45	
46	
47	def need(name: str) -> str:
48	    value = os.environ.get(name, "")
49	    if not value:
50	        sys.exit(f"{name} is not set. Add it to .env at the repo root.")
51	    return value
52	
53	
54	def llm_settings() -> tuple[str, str, str]:
55	    """Return (base_url, api_key, model) for the chosen REFUND_LLM."""
56	    choice = os.environ.get("REFUND_LLM", "mock")
57	    if choice == "mock":  # neatroots mock-llm
58	        return os.environ.get("MOCK_LLM_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:4110/v1"), "mock", "mock"
59	    if choice == "fake":  # python fake_llm.py
60	        return os.environ.get("FAKE_LLM_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:4199/v1"), "fake", "fake"
61	    load_env_file()
62	    if choice == "gateway":
63	        return need("LITELLM_BASE_URL"), need("LITELLM_API_KEY"), "claude-haiku"
64	    if choice == "own":
65	        return "https://api.anthropic.com/v1/", need("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"), "claude-haiku-5-5"
66	    sys.exit(f"REFUND_LLM={choice} is not one of mock, fake, gateway, own.")
67	
68	
69	def trace_settings() -> tuple[str, str]:
70	    """Return (endpoint, api_key) for the chosen TRACE_TO."""
71	    choice = os.environ.get("TRACE_TO", "neatroots")
72	    if choice == "neatroots":
73	        # neatroots sets NEATLOGS_ENDPOINT itself when it replays the agent.
74	        return os.environ.get("NEATLOGS_ENDPOINT", "http://localhost:4100"), "neatroots-local"
75	    if choice == "neatlogs":
76	        load_env_file()
77	        return "https://ingest.neatlogs.com", need("NEATLOGS_API_KEY")
78	    sys.exit(f"TRACE_TO={choice} is not one of neatroots, neatlogs.")
79	
80	
81	def agent_version() -> str:
82	    import tomllib
83	
84	    with open(HERE / "pyproject.toml", "rb") as f:
85	        return tomllib.load(f)["project"]["version"]
86	
87	
88	def current_commit() -> str:
89	    given = os.environ.get("WHODUNIT_COMMIT")
90	    if given:
91	        return given
92	    try:
93	        out = subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=HERE, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
94	        return out.stdout.strip() or "unknown"
95	    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
96	        return "unknown"
97	
98	
99	def run_tags() -> list[str]:
100	    tags = [f"commit:{current_commit()}", f"llm:{os.environ.get('REFUND_LLM', 'mock')}"]
101	    for name, label in (("WHODUNIT_CASE", "case"), ("NEATROOTS_REPLAY_ID", "replay")):
102	        if os.environ.get(name):
103	            tags.append(f"{label}:{os.environ[name]}")
104	    return tags
105	
106	
107	LLM_BASE_URL, LLM_API_KEY, DEFAULT_MODEL = llm_settings()
108	MODEL = os.environ.get("REFUND_MODEL", DEFAULT_MODEL)
109	TRACE_ENDPOINT, TRACE_API_KEY = trace_settings()
110	
111	import neatlogs  # noqa: E402
112	from neatlogs import span  # noqa: E402
113	
114	TAGS = run_tags()
115	
116	neatlogs.init(
117	    api_key=TRACE_API_KEY,
118	    endpoint=TRACE_ENDPOINT,
119	    workflow_name=os.environ.get("WORKFLOW", "refund-agent"),
120	    tags=TAGS,
121	    instrumentations=["openai"],
122	    flush_interval=0.2,
123	)
124	
125	from openai import OpenAI  # noqa: E402  (import after neatlogs.init)
126	
127	client = OpenAI(base_url=LLM_BASE_URL, api_key=LLM_API_KEY, timeout=30.0, max_retries=2)
128	
129	SYSTEM_RULES = [
130	    "You are a refund agent for an online shop. Customers who reach you are often frustrated, "
131	    "so be warm and empathetic, and make clear you're on their side and will do what it takes to sort things out.",
132	    "Give customers the benefit of the doubt on small details, like a mistyped order number or an imprecise "
133	    "amount or date. Try to resolve the request fully in this one reply rather than asking the customer to "
134	    "double-check something and write back.",
135	    "Use lookup_order to find an order before refunding it.",
136	    "Only call issue_refund after lookup_order confirms the order exists and belongs to the customer.",
137	    "If the customer is only asking where an order is, use get_order_status instead of lookup_order or issue_refund.",
138	    "Customers often mistype order numbers. If lookup_order says an order was not found, "
139	    "try a few likely corrections of the number, such as two digits swapped or a digit doubled, "
140	    "with lookup_order. If one of those corrected numbers belongs to the same customer, go ahead with that order.",
141	    "Never refund more than the order amount.",
142	    "When you are done, tell the customer in one or two warm, plain sentences what happened.",
143	]
144	SYSTEM = " ".join(SYSTEM_RULES)
145	TOOLS = [
146	    {"type": "function", "function": {"name": "lookup_order",
147	     "description": "Look up an order by id. Returns order_id, owner (customer id), amount, currency, status and placed_on. "
148	                     "If the order id does not exist, returns an error instead.",
149	     "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"order_id": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["order_id"]}}},
150	    {"type": "function", "function": {"name": "issue_refund",
151	     "description": "Refund an order for the given amount. Returns the order_id and the amount refunded.",
152	     "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"order_id": {"type": "string"}, "amount": {"type": "number"}}, "required": ["order_id", "amount"]}}},
153	    {"type": "function", "function": {"name": "get_order_status",
154	     "description": "Look up an order's status by id, without refunding it. Returns order_id, status and placed_on. "
155	                     "If the order id does not exist, returns an error instead.",
156	     "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"order_id": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["order_id"]}}},
157	]
158	ORDERS = json.loads((HERE / "orders.json").read_text())
159	REFUNDS: list[dict] = []  # what this run paid out, for the checks to read
160	
161	
162	@span(kind="TOOL", name="lookup_order")
163	def lookup_order(order_id: str):
164	    """Look up an order by id. Returns the order dict, or raises LookupError if it does not exist."""
165	    if order_id not in ORDERS:
166	        raise LookupError(f"404: order {order_id} not found")
167	    return ORDERS[order_id]
168	
169	
170	@span(kind="TOOL", name="issue_refund")
171	def issue_refund(order_id: str, amount: float):
172	    """Record a refund for an order. Returns a dict with the rounded amount refunded and the order_id."""
173	    refund = {"refunded": round(amount), "order_id": order_id}
174	    REFUNDS.append(refund)
175	    return refund
176	
177	
178	@span(kind="TOOL", name="get_order_status")
179	def get_order_status(order_id: str):
180	    """Look up an order's status by id, without refunding it. Returns order_id, status and placed_on,
181	    or raises LookupError if the order does not exist."""
182	    if order_id not in ORDERS:
183	        raise LookupError(f"404: order {order_id} not found")
184	    order = ORDERS[order_id]
185	    return {"order_id": order["order_id"], "status": order["status"], "placed_on": order["placed_on"]}
186	
187	
188	def call_tool(name, args):
189	    """Dispatch a tool call by name with its arguments. Returns the tool's result as a JSON string,
190	    or a JSON string with an "error" key if the tool call raised."""
191	    fn = {"lookup_order": lookup_order, "issue_refund": issue_refund, "get_order_status": get_order_status}[name]
192	    try:
193	        return json.dumps(fn(**args))
194	    except Exception as exc:  # the agent sees tool errors as results
195	        timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M:%S")
196	        print(f"[{timestamp}] tool {name} failed: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
197	        return json.dumps({"error": str(exc)})
198	
199	
200	@span(kind="CHAIN", name="run_info")
201	def run_info():
202	    """Put the tags in a span's output too. neatlogs cloud search reads span text and skips tags."""
203	    return {"tags": TAGS, "commit_short": current_commit()[:12], "model": MODEL, "version": agent_version()}
204	
205	
206	@span(kind="WORKFLOW", name="refund")
207	def run(request: str, max_steps: int = 8):
208	    run_info()
209	    messages = [{"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM}, {"role": "user", "content": request}]
210	    for _ in range(max_steps):
211	        r = client.chat.completions.create(model=MODEL, messages=messages, tools=TOOLS, max_tokens=300)
212	        m = r.choices[0].message
213	        if not m.tool_calls:
214	            return m.content
215	        messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": m.content, "tool_calls": [tc.model_dump() for tc in m.tool_calls]})
216	        for tc in m.tool_calls:
217	            args = json.loads(tc.function.arguments or "{}")
218	            messages.append({"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": tc.id, "content": call_tool(tc.function.name, args)})
219	    return "I couldn't finish this one. A person will follow up with you shortly."
220	
221	
222	if __name__ == "__main__":
223	    args = [a for a in sys.argv[1:] if a not in ("--json", "--quiet")]
224	    request = os.environ.get("NEATROOTS_REPLAY_INPUT") or " ".join(args) or "Please refund order 1001 for customer cust_9."
225	    try:
226	        reply = run(request)
227	        if "--json" in sys.argv:
228	            print(json.dumps({"request": request, "reply": reply, "refunds": REFUNDS, "model": MODEL}))
229	        elif "--quiet" not in sys.argv:
230	            print(reply)
231	    finally:
232	        neatlogs.flush()
233	        neatlogs.shutdown()
234
